tool.name: BAA

param.name: metroLayer
param.dialogReference: This field specifies the point layer containing the source POIs (centers of the buffers).

param.name: zoneFieldM
param.displayname: 选择源兴趣点（POI）的区域名称字段
param.dialogReference: This field specifies the field that defines zones (e.g., districts) for the source POIs.

param.name: districtLayer
param.dialogReference: This field specifies the polygon layer define the boundary of each zone.

param.name: zoneFieldD
param.displayname: 选择区域图层的区域名称字段
param.dialogReference: This field specifies the field that defines zones for the polygon layer.
param.pythonReference: NOTE: Ensure that the values in the Select zone name field of source POI and Select zone name field of district layer correspond to the same zones. It is strongly recommended to use the District Divid script to generate the zone name field for the Source POI Layer from the District Layer.

param.name: bufferSyntax
param.dialogReference: This field defines the buffer radii in meters using a Python list comprehension.
param.pythonReference:
EXAMPLE:

1. Define specific buffer distances (e.g., 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 1000 meters)

[10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 1000]

2. Generate a range of distances from 10 to 2000 meters with an interval of 10 meters

[10 * x for x in range(1,201)]

param.name: savePath
param.dialogReference:
• Enter the base name for the output CSV file (do not include the .csv extension).

  • The results will be saved as CSV files.

  • The result contains four columns:

    - city: The name of the zone, as defined by the Select zone name field of source POI.

    - distance: The radius of the buffer (in meters).

    - Num: The area of the buffer ring (in square meters) intersecting with the corresponding city boundary for the corresponding city and distance.

    - totalNum: The total area (in square meters) of the corresponding city.

tool.summary:
This is a specialized script that performs buffer analysis based solely on the buffer area. It builds multi‑ring buffers around source points and calculates the area of each buffer ring intersecting with the specified district boundaries.

For more information, please refer to the online tool documentation
